1. The present appeal is filed under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 read with Section 96 of the Civil Procedure Code, 1908 challenging the impugned judgment and award dated 02.12.2013 by learned 3rd Additional Senior Civil Judge, Palanpur passed in Land Acquisition Reference Case No.594 of 1999 arising out of group of Land Acquisition Reference Case Nos.590 to 606 of 1999.

2. Heard learned advocate Mr. Rakesh R. Patel for the appellants, learned Assistant Government Pleader Mr. Rahul Dave and learned advocate Mr. Parv S. Gupta for the respective respondents.

3. The brief facts of the case are as under:-
3.1. The lands of the claimants situated at Village-Nokha, Taluka Deodar,
District-Banaskantha was acquired for the purpose of construction of Canal in Narmada Project by the acquiring body.
Notification under Section 4 was published on 22.01.1997 and Notification under Section 6 was published on 29.03.1997.
The Land Acquisition Officer awarded compensation of Rs.2.05/- per square metres under Section 11 of the Act on 11.06.1999.
Being aggrieved with the said decision awarded under Section 11 of the Act, claimants preferred references under Section 18 of the Act.

After considering the evidence and material available on record, learned Reference Court vide impugned judgment and award NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/3932/2024 JUDGMENT DATED: 06/10/2025 undefined dated 02.12.2013 awarded additional compensation at Rs.22.20 per square metres (Rs.22.20 paisa less Rs.2.05 paisa =Rs.20.15paisa).
Being aggrieved and dissatisfied with the impugned judgment and award, the appellants-claimants have filed the present First Appeal.

4. Learned advocate for the appellants has contended that the land of the appellants-claimants situated at Village Nokha Taluka Deodar, District-Banaskantha was acquired for the purpose of construction of Canal in Narmada Project.
Notification under Section 4 of the Act was published on 22.01.1997 and Notification under Section 6 was published on 29.03.1997.
The award under Section 11 was declared by the Land Acquisition Officer awarding Rs.2.05/- as compensation on 11.06.1999.
The said award was assailed before the learned Reference Court under Section 18 of the Act.

Learned Reference Court awarded less compensation as additional compensation and therefore,
claimants are before this Court.

It is further NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/3932/2024 JUDGMENT DATED: 06/10/2025 undefined contended that the present appeal is arising out of Land Acquisition Reference Case No.594 of 1999 which is from the group of Land Acquisition Reference Case Nos.590 of 1999 to 606 of 1999.

sentences.text: It is contended that First Appeal No.523 of 2018 arising out of the LAR No.590 of 1999 has been decided by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 01.08.2023 and has partly allowed the appeals and claimants were held to be entitled to additional compensation of Rs.58.85/- paisa per square metres with statutory benefits.
The copy of the said order has been placed on record by learned advocate for the appellants and the same is taken on record.
It is further contended that the present appeal be decided in the same line and additional compensation of Rs.58.85/- paisa be awarded with allstatutory benefits.
Learned advocate for the appellants has placed on record a copy of order dated 15.06.2023 upholding the order passed in First Appeal No.1841 of 2023, which is taken on record.
Except above, no other submissions are canvassed by learned advocate for the appellants.

sentences.text: 5. Per contra, learned advocate for the respective respondents could not contradict the aforesaid factual position.

6. Considering the peculiar set of facts and considering the fact that the First Appeal No.523 of 2018 and allied matters which are arising out of group LAR Nos.592 to 606 of 1999, have been decided by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 01.08.2023, present First Appeal is required to be decided in the same line.
As the facts in all group of matters are idential and the issues are akin in each matter.
This Court is not delving into the other details of the matter.

It also appears from the order dated 01.08.2023 passed in First Appeal No.523 of 2018 and allied matter that the First Appeal No.1841 of 2023 was pertaining to village Nokha and the date of notification under Section 4 was published on 04.12.1996 whereas in the present appeal, notification under Section 4 was published on 22.01.1997.
The difference between the two dates of notification is hardly two months.

In the decision of First Appeal No.1841 of NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/3932/2024 JUDGMENT DATED: 06/10/2025 undefined 2023, the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court has awarded additional compensation of Rs.58.85 paise per square metres.

7. Considering the aforesaid aspects and considering the facts, the judgment and award dated 02.12.2013 by learned 3 rd Additional Senior Civil Judge, Palanpur passed in Land Acquisition Reference Case No.594 of 1999 is required to be modified and the same is modified.

Resultantly, First Appeal is partly allowed.
In view of the order passed in the main matter, the Connected Civil Application does not survive and the same is disposed of.
